denominator: UTF-8 bytes of the ORIGINAL text via row['original_bytes']; for perturbed sets this is the unmodified text length (evalprep sets original_bytes from the original).
eos_policy: Identical for every arm: each window is [EOS]+span; cross-entropy scores only the text-token positions; EOS is context and is never a target (docs/M9_PREREG.md Evaluation windows; python/ancoda_tok/m9/bpb.py _score_spans).

independent_recompute.note: Standalone uses torch+tokenizers/sentencepiece only (model arch inlined). Pipeline reference uses ancoda_tok.m9.bpb.score_ids. Ran on ancoda-server XPU.
independent_recompute.sample: first 300 sealed Nepali docs by doc_id order

same_eval_docs.note: Every arm/seed final and bstar JSON has identical per-group docs and bytes. All arms scored the same eval_dir contents.
